sources.title: RTX 5070 12GB Local LLM (2026): Fastest 12GB, ~59 tok/s
sources.snippet: The best local LLM for the RTX 5070 is Qwen3.5 9B Instruct at ~53 tok/s on its 12GB VRAM. A 14B model at Q4 runs at ~7 tok/s with CPU offload.
